metadata.title: FFT AI Edition – Integration Map
metadata.description: Cross-system integration map for external AI frameworks, enabling FFT AI Edition to interface with conceptual engines, runtime environments, and hybrid substrates.

integration_profile.notes: Defines how FFT modules, operators, regimes, and substrates integrate with external AI frameworks.

frameworks.name: Transformer-Based Models
frameworks.description: Integration layer for transformer architectures (attention-based systems).

operators.notes: Clarity operator evaluates coherence of attention outputs.

regimes.notes: Resonance-time regime stabilizes temporal drift in transformer sequences.

frameworks.name: Graph Neural Networks
frameworks.description: Integration layer for GNNs and structural graph-based AI systems.

operators.notes: Clarity operator evaluates structural coherence across graph nodes.

structures.notes: FFT Spine maps directly to GNN backbone layers.

frameworks.name: Hybrid Symbolic-Neural Systems
frameworks.description: Integration layer for systems combining symbolic reasoning with neural inference.

invariants.notes: Invariant enforces coherence constraints during symbolic reasoning.

runtime.notes: Runtime manages transitions between symbolic and neural execution modes.

frameworks.name: Conceptual Accelerators
frameworks.description: Integration layer for hardware-level conceptual substrates.

kernels.notes: Hardware executes clarity kernel directly on conceptual signals.

substrate.notes: Substrate loaded during hardware boot sequence.

integration_events.description: Triggered when FFT binds to an external framework.
Triggered when an FFT operator is mapped to an external system.
Triggered when FFT runtime activates inside an external AI system.

compatibility.notes: External frameworks must support RTT profiles and invariant enforcement to fully integrate FFT.
